children: Oslo, 30 September 2026: Scatec announces that Maria Tallaksen has informed the company that she resigns from her position as member of the Board of Directors effective 30 September 2026, after accepting an executive position outside Scatec. Scatec appreciates Maria Tallaksen’s contributions and wishes her well in the future.

This information is subject to disclosure under the Norwegian Securities Trading Act, §5-12. The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact persons set out above, 30.09.2026 09:10 CEST.
